confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough. Beer and coffee come from Expatistan and Whereandwhen averages with few price points, and the meal figures come from a French comparison site and MyLifeElsewhere, so they are not reliable. Cocktail and wine rest on an Expatistan club average and a bottle price, not a glass price; wine was estimated from the bottle price and local price levels rather than from beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings or search results. The FX observation is stale: the only RBA observation I could retrieve is from 20 March 2026, and I could not retrieve a newer official RBA value. Non-RBA sources from November 2026 suggest roughly 0.68 to 0.70 USD per AUD, but I have not used them as the source rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Darwin-specific price points where available, with the accommodation tiers from general knowledge of a small Northern Territory tourist city with a seasonal (dry season) demand peak.
